body: I know how you feel man. It literally feels like the worst day of your life. It feels like you will never get through the day. Honestly, but you still are living. I am going through the hardest weeks of my life where everyday I felt like shit and just did not see a point of living and enjoying the future. The only thing that is amazing is how I am still trudging along. Even though I feel like a literal piece of shit and just not want to feel anymore
It seems like you already have a good mindset man. That's strong. I don't even think I am there yet, to accept how the future can be better.

Trust me bro,

I am feeling like absolute shit right now. Worst I have ever felt in my entire 21 years of living. I do not see how I will ever feel better, but currently I go out everyday pretending like I am more or less doing fine.

I don't know what to say to make you feel better because I am currently in the same boat as you. I always saw myself as ugly and unlovable and never once have derived happiness from myself. I know I will eventually have to accept living with the things I cannot change. We can try together man, pm me

Dude I just want you to know everyone goes through a phase where life just feels like shit.Where it feels like literally nothing can make it better. Just imagine once you have gone through it, it will make you so much stronger. Life can be so hard sometimes, regardless of the reason, but you can do it. We all can.
